validationScope: Duplicate-key YAML parsing, local references, targeted semantic checks and frontend mock denials; NOT full OpenAPI validation or runtime verification

findings.issue: Global servers apply both API groups to every path; x-api-group does not override OpenAPI routing. Use operation-level servers or separate specs.
BookingItemFinancial allOf is unsatisfiable: closed base rejects money fields and closed extension rejects required base fields. Flatten the financial projection with one closed property set.
Recovery admin items/paging/projection differs from existing customer curPage/nextPage/items. Do not adapt customer readers or infer unobserved pagination/timestamp serialization.
Unscoped super_admin all-tenant access and finance expand October 31 conservative explicit-tenant/no-finance proposal; policy is not approved by this receipt.
D-1 through D-4 remain uncoded/unvalidated. Error enums and 409 mapping are intended, not observed Xano wire behavior. Removing Idempotency-Key does not establish safe transition retry.
Equal file counts do not verify byte identity or no writes. Count deltas alone do not establish exactly one missing table or its identity; compare full VFS keys/hashes to supplied inventory.

P2 reclaim/release/complete check-then-write races remain. P5 liveness-read followed by deletion is also TOCTOU; uniqueness alone does not prove stale-delete or lease safety. P6 physical atomicity and all-writer enforcement remain unverified.
Different datasource names and broad CRUD grants do not establish physical separation, denial of workspace 3, provider egress control or expiry. Existing isolation prerequisites remain.
